reasons: UNSUPPORTED: "Plus jeune champion du monde de l'histoire, à 17 ans, en dépassant le record de van Gerwen établi en 2014 à 24 ans" (La DH confirms the youngest champion at 17 and that van Gerwen was champion in 2014 at 24, but does not call it a record Littler broke. The Sky page gives van Gerwen's 2014 mark as the youngest world No 1 record (24y251d), not the youngest champion record. Fix: say he was the youngest champion (La DH), and drop the record claim or cite a source for it.)

UNSUPPORTED: "Il a ensuite battu Humphries en finale et conservé le trophée" (The fetched Sky page says he went back-to-back (fourth to do so in Wolverhampton) but does not name the final opponent or score. Cite a final report or drop the opponent.)

UNSUPPORTED: "L'écart s'explique par la date : le chiffre de Sky précède les titres de 2026" (Causal explanation. The Sky 2026 page does not discuss the major count. The dates support only that the 8-major figure is from Nov 2025 and the 13-major figure from Oct 2026. State the dates and drop the causal claim.)

Reviewer recommends rejection: Most claims are confirmed. Three are unsupported: the youngest-champion 'record' attribution to La DH and Sky, the Humphries-in-the-final detail, and the causal explanation for the 8 vs 13 majors gap. The Netflix Tudum byline is dated 22 Oct 2026, and the 30 Oct 2026 broadcast at 3 p.m. ET is confirmed. The Friday weekday comes from What's on Netflix. The Sky 81,500 wording is on reaching the final, as the article says. Of 42 claims: 39 confirmed, 3 unsupported, 0 wrong.
